scope: Static review and planning. Entries marked confirmed are source/evidence observations, not reproduced gameplay defects.

records.title: Literal low-memory reader differs
records.acceptance: Keep original physical086C read and modulo subtraction. Prove any native replacement and reachability separately; retain original receipt.

records.title: Fixed DS/SS, synthetic stack and raw alias semantics
records.acceptance: Define actual native caller domains, all writers/lifetimes and explicit adapters to independent DS/SS bus contracts; do not inherit old test passes onto narrower APIs.

records.title: 20-bit addressing and multi-byte memory access
records.acceptance: Compare high-segment and word/dword boundary cases; implement wrapping or prove bounded valid-state exclusions.

records.title: Arithmetic portability and inherited register assumptions
records.acceptance: Resolve signed overflow/shifts, INT32_MIN/-1, inherited CH/SI/BP/DI and all affected caller contracts with meaningful original-byte cases.

records.title: Timing, simulation divisor, RNG and speaker synthesis
records.acceptance: Compare sequencer/timer/simulation/event/RNG ordering under original fixtures; validate PCM separately. Do not label100Hz callbacks as100Hz simulation.

records.title: Writes to selected original-data directory
records.acceptance: Introduce user-profile selection/high-score overlay; prove absent/read-only data-directory operation and original hash/mtime/attribute preservation.

records.title: Heuristic edition admission and incomplete loader bounds
records.acceptance: Pin admitted EGA image and ordered relocation identity; reject malformed/truncated structures, allocation overflow and out-of-range relocations explicitly.

records.title: Protection, disk/install and robustness changes
records.acceptance: Record each removed/changed path, original contract, valid caller profile and selected native behavior; no silent parity credit.

records.title: Short stage DAT zero-fill and original heap-tail reads
records.acceptance: Compare7774-byte copy and subsequent consumers/lifetimes for short stages; do not infer absent bytes are unused or authentic zeros.

records.title: Zero/full LOOP behavior and AI/cockpit edge policies
records.acceptance: Reconcile full raw LOOP contracts, neutral-grind omission, clipping, stale AI/cockpit registers and police fallbacks; establish reachable-domain evidence before excluding cases.

records.title: Compiled game text, font bytes and resource-derived tables
records.acceptance: Classify every imported string/table; externalize original media from user EXE/data; exclude payload-bearing reference documentation and generated arrays from packages.

records.title: All-file schemas and corpus evidence absent
records.acceptance: Admit schemas by consumer and full supplied corpus: both PCS prefixes, sprite count discrepancy, CAMA49-byte tail, ordered SS, SGN/FNT gaps and VOICES adjacency. Retain malformed and trailing-byte checks.

records.title: Index starts, symbol conflicts and global Ghidra DS pin
records.acceptance: Reconcile27 upstream-only and23 local-only starts and76 symbol naming conflicts; retain range-specific DS/SS contexts. Never run global SetDS on accepted projects.

records.title: SDL-dependent C11 global-state architecture
records.acceptance: Provide C17 headless build, deterministic host-independent state, explicit provider interfaces and second-compiler/host evidence without a second simulation.

records.title: CGA, Amiga, Northern Germany and switching absent
records.acceptance: Preserve all existing phase gates and conditional scenery obligations; indexes/names do not count as implemented native features.

records.title: No retained independent candidate acceptance suite
records.acceptance: Pin source/build/dependencies and transfer original-byte representative checks, then complete corpus/session/visual/audio/package acceptance separately. --check only loads the EXE.

records.title: Reference clone rejected by original-only verifier
records.acceptance: Separate exact clone manifest; unchanged250-original manifest; readonly113clonefiles,85Gitblobmatches; regression cases reject altered/missing/unlisted/escaping paths.

records.title: Reuse provenance and unmeasured effort reduction
records.acceptance: Preserve MIT notices and commit/change provenance per imported file. Measure5-10engineerday spike before replacing historical effort ranges; no full-project percentage claim.
